# Generated code — do not edit

Everything under this directory except this file is generated from `proto/` by
`make proto`. Editing it by hand achieves nothing: the next `make proto` deletes and
rewrites it (`clean: true` in `proto/buf.gen.yaml`).

It is committed on purpose, so a fresh clone builds without installing `buf`.
`.gitattributes` marks it `linguist-generated` and suppresses it from diffs.

| Language | Directory | Generated since |
|---|---|---|
| C# | `csharp/` | month 0.5 |
| Go | `go/` | month 2 — plugin commented out in `proto/buf.gen.yaml` until then |
| Python | `python/` | month 3 |
| Java | `java/` | month 4 |
